svg.title: NET-03-E — Editable player-hosted connection
svg.desc: Develop's shared directory/direct task on an 850 by 700 logical canvas, with the required explicit service-type selector. Directory endpoint and identity remain intact. Fixed endpoint and footer regions surround two scrolling setup panels. Required-password browser entry initially focuses Password; direct player-hosted entry initially focuses Address.

g.text: Local players: 1 • Session-only scores • Optional scripts disabled
Round 1 in progress. You will play immediately if admitted.
The host confirms availability when you connect.
ANNOTATIONS: Directory endpoint is not replaced by the pilot default. Headings and footer stay fixed.
Direct entry uses optional-password help and context-specific endpoint-only identity guidance.
No password dialog. Connecting uses NET-03's locked roster; pilot invitations use NET-03-P.
